# Copilot Instructions

This is a static frontend-only website intended to be hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Project Rules
- Pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript only — no build tools, no frameworks, no bundlers.
- All files must work without a local server (use relative paths).
- Keep the structure flat and simple: `index.html`, `css/`, `js/`, `assets/`.
- Do not add backend code, Node.js, or any server-side logic.
- Target GitHub Pages compatibility: `index.html` at the repository root is the entry point.

## Checklist
- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md
- [ ] Scaffold project (index.html, css/style.css, js/main.js)
- [ ] Create VS Code task (Live Server or similar)
- [ ] Write README with GitHub Pages deployment steps
